shortDescription: Manage filesystem snapshot on the Unity storage system

options.name: auto_delete
options.description: This option specifies whether or not the filesystem snapshot will be automatically deleted. If set to C(true), the filesystem snapshot will expire based on the pool auto deletion policy. If set to C(false), the filesystem snapshot will not be auto deleted based on the pool auto deletion policy. Option I(auto_delete) can not be set to C(true), if I(expiry_time) is specified. If during creation neither I(auto_delete) nor I(expiry_time) is mentioned then the filesystem snapshot will be created keep

options.name: description
options.description: The additional information about the filesystem snapshot can be provided using this option. The description can be removed by passing an empty string.

options.name: expiry_time
options.description: This option is for specifying the date and time after which the filesystem snapshot will expire. The time is to be mentioned in UTC timezone. The format is "MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM". Year must be in 4 digits.

options.name: filesystem_id
options.description: The ID of the Filesystem for which snapshot is created. For creation of filesystem snapshot either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required. Not required for other operations.

options.name: filesystem_name
options.description: The name of the Filesystem for which snapshot is created. For creation of filesystem snapshot either I(filesystem_name) or I(filesystem_id) is required. Not required for other operations.

options.name: fs_access_type
options.description: Access type of the filesystem snapshot. Required only during creation of filesystem snapshot. If not given, snapshot's access type will be C(Checkpoint).

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: The ID of the NAS server in which the Filesystem is created. For creation of filesystem snapshot either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required. Not required for other operations.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: The name of the NAS server in which the Filesystem is created. For creation of filesystem snapshot either I(nas_server_name) or I(nas_server_id) is required. Not required for other operations.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: During creation snapshot_id is auto generated. For all other operations either I(snapshot_id) or I(snapshot_name) is required.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: The name of the filesystem snapshot. Mandatory parameter for creating a filesystem snapshot. For all other operations either I(snapshot_name) or I(snapshot_id) is required.

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to mention the existence of the filesystem snapshot.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
